verdict.rationale: Expensify's docs promise automatic merchant/date/total capture (SmartScan), AI-driven categorization, multi-level GL coding, and syncing to QuickBooks/NetSuite so reports are close-ready, but hands-on community reports directly contradict the categorization claim, citing ~70% miscategorization and slow, human-mediated (mechanical turk) receipt processing that undermines 'real-time coding'. Missing for 10: independent verification that categorization accuracy has improved, more recent (post-mturk-era) hands-on accounts confirming reliable real-time coding, and evidence of memo/note fields being auto-populated.
